definitions.explanation: Difficulty or suffering endured through life's challenges.
The effort put into achieving something.

examples.japanese: {苦労|くろう}して⟦{成功|せいこう}した→成功する：02638_seikou⟧。
お{苦労|くろう}さまでした。
examples.english: Thank you for your hard work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子育|こそだ}て→子育て：12226_kosodate⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦労|くろう}
{苦労|くろう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけて⟦すみません→すみません：00998_sumimasen⟧。
examples.english: I'm sorry to cause you trouble.

examples.japanese: ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{苦労|くろう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{分|わ}かる→分かる：00463_wakaru⟧⟦ように→ように：10081_youni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I've come to understand my parents' hardships.

examples.english: My years of hard work were rewarded, and I was finally able to open my own shop.

notes:
{苦労|くろう} expresses hardship and effort.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {苦労|くろう}する (to have difficulty, to struggle)
- {苦労|くろう}をかける (to cause trouble for someone)
- {苦労|くろう}が{絶|た}えない (hardships never end)
- {苦労|くろう}が{報|むく}われる (efforts are rewarded)

SET EXPRESSIONS:
- お{苦労|くろう}さま(です) (thank you for your effort)
- {苦労|くろう}{人|にん}/{苦労|くろう}{性|しょう} (someone who has known hardship)
- {苦労|くろう}{話|ばなし} (tales of hardship)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {苦労|くろう}: hardship (often life difficulties)
- {努力|どりょく}: effort (more positive, self-motivated)
- {苦|く}しむ: to suffer (verb)
